## What changed

Describe the module and the behavior added or fixed. Link the task/issue if there is one.

## How to check it

Give exact dashboard actions, fictional input and expected results. State which build and manual checks you actually ran; list anything not tested.

## Shared code or database changes

List affected shared interfaces, schema changes, migration/import steps and coordination needed. Write "None" if there are none.

## Before review

- [ ] Build passes and feature works through the dashboard.
- [ ] Changed forms include matching .java/.form files and open in Design.
- [ ] Relevant persistence, invalid-input and failure cases checked.
- [ ] No local credentials, real records or target files included.
- [ ] Documentation updated; unfinished behavior clearly identified.
